I am farming rice on this 0.85 hectare plot here in Mwanza. The rains come once a year from November, so I must plant at the right time and hope the season is good. I have some schooling and a bigger farm overall (almost 7 hectares), so I can afford a little urea for the rice, but fertilizer is expensive and I use it carefully. I will use my own saved seed like most of us here, and my family will do most of the work, though I will hire a few people for transplanting and harvesting since rice needs many hands at those times.
